checklist.evidence: Traced peer-controlled frames through bounded parsing, exact lifetime/session checks and typed responder IDs. Mutation admission is serialized with authority checks; interruption is explicit; uncertain delivery and cleanup remain retained rather than successful. Spawn uses executable plus argv, not a shell.

Reviewed exact advertised setting IDs, independent option identity, ambiguous semantic-category rejection, sequential acknowledgements and prompt readiness. Requested, reported, changed and unreported states remain distinct; config setters require value-confirming responses.

Reviewed profile validation, credential-free catalog projection, shell-free executable resolution and explicit unavailable errors. Executable metadata follows symlinks without replacing the invocation pathname with the canonical target.

Reviewed ACP start/open/attach routing, explicit controller handling, exact settings serialization and native input parsing. Human launch does not invent a temporary external controller or interpolate a shell command.
Reviewed private local socket paths, bounded framing, connection-error distinctions, liveness probes and shutdown handles supporting attachment fencing. No automatic mutation retry was identified.

Traced project selection, ACP reserve/claim/start ordering and authority-checked action dispatch. Native input routes reject ACP targets, daemon runtime identity is exposed for continuity checks, and local socket/shutdown handling preserves owned cleanup.
Reviewed module wiring; settings and profile integration introduce no alternate authority or execution entry point.

Reviewed ACP profile schema, validation, loading, overrides and persistence with surrounding configuration locking. Trusted user configuration is not treated as agent-supplied executable configuration.

Traced detach/disconnect/pause supervision, daemon and exact-target continuity, acknowledged-launch identity preservation, stale-event draining and structural geometry reconciliation before recovery readiness. Recovery does not ensure/start a replacement daemon.

Reviewed exact target/control/generation draft binding, deliberate form review and permission selection, shared validation and definite-rejection-only restoration. Revocation discards stale drafts; transport uncertainty does not restore/replay them. Dynamic ACP content is rendered inertly.

Traced original observation and authority socket checks before queued dispatch and again after claim observation, pause heartbeat fencing, non-replay teardown, force paint/drain confirmation and guarded idle recovered-observer cleanup. Successful launch salvage preserves identity only.
Reviewed explicit launch dialog actions, bounded settings overrides and preservation of untouched structured profile defaults, including delimiter-containing option IDs and values.
Reviewed surface projection and ownership presentation. Private capability references are not rendered, and ACP dynamic text does not become terminal instructions.

Reviewed regression source for stale tuples/generations, force and cancelled claims, retained RPCs, genuine forms and offered permissions, first-valid responder ordering, privacy, bounded hostile transport, explicit interruption and unknown delivery/cleanup.
Reviewed controlling-PTY scenarios covering stale draft/input non-replay, cooperative question handoff, original-connection activity provenance, inert hostile rendering and owned cleanup assertions.
Reviewed acceptance-driver source and causal same-instance identity/work assertions. Synthetic/native driver assertions were not treated as observed installed-OMP acceptance.
Reviewed deliberate CLI/native launch, profile/settings presentation and surviving-attachment workflows, including authority preservation and no duplicate launch/input assertions.

Reviewed opt-in genuine OMP driver, explicit private-input ownership/mode checks, budget-gate requirements, original-instance question/permission effects and restricted diagnostic handling. No supplied private input or live evidence was opened.

Reviewed OMP-shaped long tool identities, exact question/permission responses, peer cancellation and requested-versus-confirmed setting behavior, including distinct legacy-mode and config-option acknowledgement requirements.
Reviewed executable availability and symlink invocation cases, shell-free argv behavior, profile/default overrides and explicit invalid or unsupported launch cases.

Reviewed deterministic protocol fixture dispatch, original response/session identities, genuine interaction shapes, hostile framing/output modes, offered permission effects and explicit settings acknowledgements. Fixture behavior is not provider compatibility proof.

Reviewed physical input gating, consumed confirmation/gesture tails, original-connection consent, keep/withdraw policy, unknown native settlement blockers, disconnect recovery and resize-before-readiness assertions.
Reviewed recovery edge scenarios for observation/authority loss, paused UI, queued stale controls, acknowledged launch continuity, observer retirement and exact surviving target identity.
Reviewed shell/native lifecycle race regression source and cleanup assertions for compatibility with stock Zsh and retained application-input uncertainty.

Reviewed ACP invocation, exact advertised settings, requested/reported/unreported policy, explicit permissions, recovery and privacy documentation. It distinguishes input admission from application settlement and does not present ACP as repairing the historical native fence.
Reviewed daily-use launch/settings/recovery change descriptions against implementation boundaries; no additional execution or privilege mechanism was introduced by the documented workflow.
Reviewed local runtime/configuration boundaries, stable identities, stock Zsh/OMP preservation and independent cleanup expectations used to assess the implementation.
Reviewed module/test/dependency declarations relevant to ACP and native acceptance. No new shell-based launch or automatic agent-installation mechanism was identified.
Reviewed locked dependency names, versions, sources, checksums and dependency relationships. This is not an advisory-database or dependency-source audit.
Reviewed only authorized lines 1–45 for settled E06 scope and acceptance boundaries. Later execution amendments were not read; plan approval was not treated as runtime proof.
Reviewed E06 same-instance ACP interoperability, explicit safe launch/settings and exact surviving recovery requirements. Deferred non-ACP E05 scope remained parked.

Reviewed attacker-controlled peer/rendering/input surfaces, identity and authority invariants, privacy and cleanup expectations, and explicit live-acceptance limits. Historical native application settlement remains unresolved, not waived or replaced with force-only acceptance.

summary: Completed independent read-only security review of all 32 frozen files, the three E06 story requirements and settled threat model. Narrow related unchanged authority and process-tree controls were inspected to complete admission, provenance and cleanup traces. No supported Must-fix, Should-fix or optional security finding survived source-to-sink analysis. Static checklist score: 32/32 = 100. PASS applies only to this static security gate, not installed-OMP interoperability or runtime acceptance.
limits: No edits, builds, tests, linters, formatters, shell/source execution, payload execution, network/provider calls, auth/config/daemon/global operations or commits were performed. No prior review/audit/runtime reports, saved handoffs/execution logs, real auth or retired private fixtures were read. Test assertions and opt-in live-driver source were inspected but not exercised; actual installed OMP same-instance question/permission effects, pause/disconnect timing, native geometry and cleanup behavior require the parent's separately authorized runtime gates. The historical unknown native/application settlement remains unresolved and must still block safe grants where applicable. Manifest hashes and branch/base provenance were read from the supplied sealed manifest, not independently recomputed or verified. Dependency advisory status and dependency internals were not audited.
